title: Simple Elytra Armor
description: This plugin adds craftable armors for your elytra allowing for flight and protection all at once.
body:
Really simple and easy plugin to setup which adds custom armor for elytras! Just drop into your plugin folder and your all set! No commands or code needed!

![Custom Recipe, use any chestplate you want!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57721d955517a60d48d7102b18cff6a1c23227f9.png)

# Roadmap

- Add custom textures to the elytras.
- Add a item like horse armor that can be put on and taken off your elytra.
- Add customizable elytra particles.
- Add the ability to allow elytra armor to fully break and become unfixable in config.

This is a solo project so please do not fully expect these to happen! 

Thank you for all of your support!
